items.title: EU plans "digital expropriation" of Europeans in the interest of AI companies
items.raw_excerpt: European privacy advocacy group noyb is criticizing plans by EU member states that it describes as a "digital expropriation" of Europeans' personal data in the interest of AI companies. The group argues these moves would weaken GDPR-based individual data protections to make it easier for AI firms to access and use personal data for model training.

title_i18n.es: La UE planea una expropiación digital de los europeos en interés de las empresas de IA.

items.title: What if we regulated AI like cars?
items.raw_excerpt: This piece explores what it would mean to regulate AI the way cars are regulated—through registration, licensing, safety standards, insurance, and liability. It argues that automotive oversight works as a layered system of rules rather than a single law, and examines where that analogy holds for AI and where it breaks down.

title_i18n.en: What if we regulated AI like cars?
title_i18n.zh: 如果我们像监管汽车一样监管人工智能会怎样？
title_i18n.es: ¿Y si reguláramos la IA como los coches?

excerpt_i18n.en: This piece explores what it would mean to regulate AI the way cars are regulated—through registration, licensing, safety standards, insurance, and liability. It argues that automotive oversight works as a layered system of rules rather than a single law, and examines where that analogy holds for AI and where it breaks down.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这篇文章借用汽车监管的经验，探讨是否应当以类似方式监管人工智能：通过登记备案、许可准入、安全标准与责任划分来约束AI的开发与部署。作者认为汽车监管并非单一规则，而是由驾照、车辆安全标准、保险与事故责任等多层机制组成，可为AI治理提供参考框架。文章据此思考哪些类比成立、哪些在AI情境下并不适用。

items.title: "80% of AI projects fail" traces to a footnote one line long
items.raw_excerpt: The article traces the widely cited claim that "80% of AI projects fail" back to a single-line footnote in a report. It argues that this thinly sourced statistic has been repeated until it hardened into conventional wisdom, cautioning readers to check such industry numbers against their original sources.

title_i18n.en: "80% of AI projects fail" traces to a footnote one line long
title_i18n.zh: 80%的AI项目失败这一说法源自一行长的脚注

excerpt_i18n.en: The article traces the widely cited claim that "80% of AI projects fail" back to a single-line footnote in a report. It argues that this thinly sourced statistic has been repeated until it hardened into conventional wisdom, cautioning readers to check such industry numbers against their original sources.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章追溯了业界广为流传的「80% 的 AI 项目失败」这一说法，指出其源头只是一份报告中仅一行长的脚注。作者认为，这个缺乏充分实证基础的统计数字被反复引用，逐渐演变为公认事实，从而影响了对 AI 项目实际成效的判断。文章借此提醒读者对广泛传播的行业数据保持审慎，回到原始出处核查。

items.title: Foremerge – Catch intent conflicts between parallel coding agents
items.raw_excerpt: At, GPTree, we run several coding agents across our team on one repo using parallel worktrees. Apart from wasted time reviewing and fixing conflicts at PR time, the failures that hurt the most are when multiple plans or tickets cause architecture changes that cannot both be true. Ex. one agent replaces a class while another one is in the process of extending it. Git only notices if the resulting patches happen to touch the same lines and the review only catches it if they are familiar with both tickets. Foremerge is a local "git like" coordination layer that sits above git (ie. does not interact with or change the way git and worktrees function), Before editing each agent publishes an intent and the scopes it will change, with the operation it plans to complete on each one. foremerge inten
